module: Disclose biometric exposure and published content

lesson.title: Human review and editorial responsibility
lesson.summary: Apply the two-part editorial exception and retain proportionate evidence of actual review and responsibility.

prerequisites.reason: The learner must distinguish operative law from interpretation and voluntary methods.
The learner must establish an in-scope publication before applying an editorial exception.

blocks: The specified text disclosure duty does not apply where the generated content has undergone a process of **human review or editorial control**, and a natural or legal person holds **editorial responsibility** for publication.

Read the logic precisely: (human review OR editorial control) AND editorial responsibility. Review/control and responsibility are distinct parts of the exception. Naming someone alone does not establish that the process occurred.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 50(4), subparagraph 2, sentence 2; Guidelines paragraphs 133-139; Code Section 2 Commitment 4
Commission Article 50 Guidelines C(2026) 5054 final; non-binding interpretation
Final Transparency Code, 10 June 2026; voluntary implementation framework

blocks: Review or control must be meaningful for the content and publication. Consider checking factual claims, sources, context and suitability, with the ability to correct content and decide what is published.
Harbour's editor examines an AI-drafted environmental report, corrects unsupported claims and approves the final text. A perfunctory click or an unread approval does not demonstrate the same process.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 50(4), subparagraph 2, sentence 2; Guidelines paragraphs 133-139; Code Section 2 Commitment 4
Commission Article 50 Guidelines C(2026) 5054 final; non-binding interpretation
Final Transparency Code, 10 June 2026; voluntary implementation framework

blocks: Editorial responsibility identifies the natural or legal person accountable for the publication. A reviewer can perform checks while the organisation holds responsibility, if the actual arrangements support that allocation.

The Code addresses documented policies and processes, assigned roles and resources, and an editorial contact where needed. It does not impose a universal requirement to create a separate record for every publication. Proportionate evidence can make the claimed exception reviewable.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 50(4), subparagraph 2, sentence 2; Guidelines paragraphs 133-139; Code Section 2 Commitment 4
Commission Article 50 Guidelines C(2026) 5054 final; non-binding interpretation
Final Transparency Code, 10 June 2026; voluntary implementation framework

blocks: An **editorial exception record**, used here as a practical worksheet, connects the final version, actual review/control, responsible person or organisation and decision. It is an evidence aid, not a statutory form.

If AI substantially rewrites the report after review and nobody reviews or controls the final publication, the previous approval cannot simply be assumed to cover it. Assess the final workflow; provider marking remains a separate question.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 50(4), subparagraph 2, sentence 2; Guidelines paragraphs 133-139; Code Section 2 Commitment 4
Commission Article 50 Guidelines C(2026) 5054 final; non-binding interpretation
Final Transparency Code, 10 June 2026; voluntary implementation framework

blocks: The same text subparagraph contains an authorised-law exception for detecting, preventing, investigating or prosecuting criminal offences. Establish that legal basis separately when relevant.

For Harbour's ordinary environmental report, choose between disclosure and a substantiated editorial exception. Do not treat the exception as permission to publish inaccurate or otherwise unlawful content.

questions.prompt: Harbour names a publication owner but nobody reads or controls the AI-generated text. Is the editorial exception established?

options.blocks: No; actual human review or editorial control is also required
options.reason: The review/control condition and responsibility condition operate together.

options.blocks: Yes; a name replaces every review process
Yes; any AI draft is automatically reviewed
options.reason: Generation does not establish human review or editorial control.

options.blocks: Reassess whether the final content underwent the qualifying process
options.reason: The evidence must support the actual published content and workflow.
